hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', ''))") || exit 2; case "$f" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; fmt_out=$(ruff format "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$fmt_out" >&2; exit 2; }; out=$(ruff check "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks claude-code post-task'
